controls.scene: minimal laundry/utility countertop; warm-neutral wall and softly blurred washer in background; clean, uncluttered
controls.product_placement: organizer fixed on countertop, centered slightly right, entire base and guide path visible

props.description: small opaque matte-white rectangular bottle with plain unbranded face and blue cap
props.start_position: front-center of lower tray, upright, label face toward camera
props.role: the only removable prop in MULTI_STEP; untouched in ATOMIC

props.description: small teal cylindrical bottle with plain unbranded face
props.role: must remain stationary in both conditions

props.description: small beige rectangular carton with plain unbranded face
props.role: must remain stationary in both conditions

nina_visibility.decision: right hand and forearm only; face, torso and all identifying features remain out of frame; no Nina identity reference
nina_visibility.why: GS-C measures mechanism and physics. Full identity would add an unrelated fidelity variable without improving observability.

controls.person_position: off-camera left; only the right hand/forearm enters from frame-left

hand_assignment.right_hand_role: all tray grip/pull/hold contacts and, in MULTI_STEP only, P1 removal/replacement and tray re-grip/close

camera.shot: static medium-close three-quarter front-left view at lower-tray height
camera.framing: whole organizer, outer front-left lip, guide axis and full open travel remain visible; hand may not occlude rail or product identity
camera.focus: continuous stable focus on organizer; moderate depth of field
camera.product_frame_coverage: approximately 60% of frame height while retaining the entire base, upper tier and travel path

lighting.shadow_behavior: soft, stable and directionally consistent; no flicker
lighting.product_visibility: black tray edges, posts and guide remain separated from background without clipped highlights or crushed shadows

controls.style: photorealistic smartphone UGC demonstration, one continuous take, no cuts, no text overlays, no logos added, no speech and no audio requirement

ATOMIC.initial_state: lower tray retracted; three props stationary
ATOMIC.final_state: tray visibly open and still held

events: replace same prop in same pose
MULTI_STEP.final_state: tray visibly retracted; all three props in original pose
